products.title: Royal Blue Mul Cotton Saree with Mustard Green Contrast Pallu, Tassels & Matching Blouse

description.plain:
Refresh your everyday ethnic wardrobe with this striking Royal Blue Mul Cotton Saree, beautifully designed with a contrasting mustard-green pallu and playful tassel detailing. Combining rich colour with the naturally comfortable feel of Mul Cotton, this saree is an effortless choice for women who prefer understated designs that still make an impression.

The saree features a deep royal blue body with a clean, minimal appearance that highlights the natural texture and graceful fall of the fabric. The pallu transitions into a distinctive mustard-green contrast, giving the saree a contemporary colour-blocked character while retaining its traditional charm.

Crafted from soft and breathable Mul Cotton, the saree feels lightweight and comfortable for extended wear. Its easy drape makes it especially suitable for office wear, everyday dressing, casual outings, college or work events, family gatherings and small festive occasions.

The pallu is finished with coordinated blue and mustard tassels along the edge, adding movement and a handcrafted finishing touch. The saree also comes with an attached blouse piece in the same colour as the contrast pallu, allowing you to create a beautifully coordinated two-tone look.

Product Details

  • Fabric: Mul Cotton
  • Saree Colour: Royal Blue
  • Pallu Colour: Mustard Green / Olive Mustard
  • Blouse: Attached blouse piece
  • Blouse Colour: Same colour as the pallu
  • Detailing: Contrast colour-block pallu with tassels
  • Feel: Soft, breathable & lightweight
  • Drape: Comfortable and easy to carry
  • Style: Minimal, contemporary & elegant
  • Occasion: Daily Wear, Office Wear, Casual Wear, Day Outings, Family Gatherings & Festive Wear

Design & Colour Story

The bold royal blue body forms the foundation of this saree, while the earthy mustard-green pallu introduces an unexpected yet sophisticated contrast. This combination gives the saree enough character to stand out while keeping the overall design clean and wearable.

The absence of heavy embellishment makes the colour combination and Mul Cotton texture the main focus, creating a saree that can easily move between casual and semi-festive styling.

How to Style

Pair the saree with its matching mustard-green blouse piece to highlight the contrast pallu. For an everyday ethnic look, add oxidised silver jhumkas, bangles, a small bindi and comfortable flats.

For office wear, keep the styling refined with stud earrings or small jhumkas, a watch, a structured handbag and neatly tied hair. The strong royal blue shade gives the outfit a polished appearance without requiring heavy accessories.

For a festive or family gathering, elevate the look with antique gold jewellery, statement earrings, bangles and a traditional potli bag. A neat bun with flowers or softly styled open hair can complete the look beautifully.

Why You'll Love It

With its breathable Mul Cotton fabric, rich royal blue body, contrasting mustard-green pallu, matching blouse piece and tassel-finished edges, this saree balances comfort with distinctive styling. It's an easy-to-wear choice for women looking for a versatile saree that works just as beautifully for a regular workday as it does for a relaxed festive gathering.

Bright, contemporary and effortlessly wearable, this Mustard Yellow Mul Cotton Saree is designed with a striking midnight blue contrast pallu for a sophisticated two-tone look. Crafted from soft and breathable Mul Cotton, the saree offers a lightweight feel and comfortable drape, making it suitable for long hours of wear. The natural texture of Mul Cotton gives the saree a relaxed elegance that works beautifully for office wear, everyday dressing, casual outings, brunches, family gatherings and small festive occasions.

The body is presented in a rich mustard yellow shade, keeping the design clean and allowing the colour and texture of the fabric to remain the focus. The pallu transitions into a contrasting midnight blue, adding depth and creating a contemporary colour-block effect.

The pallu is finished with tassels along the edge, lending a playful traditional detail to the otherwise minimal design. An attached blouse piece in the same midnight blue colour as the pallu completes the saree and creates a beautifully coordinated contrast.

The saree brings together the warmth of mustard yellow and the depth of midnight blue. This high-contrast pairing creates a distinctive appearance while remaining sophisticated enough for everyday dressing.

Instead of relying on prints or heavy embellishments, the design celebrates solid colours, natural fabric texture and a statement contrast pallu. The tassel detailing provides the final traditional accent, making the saree simple yet visually interesting.

How to Style

Pair the saree with its midnight blue attached blouse piece for a complete contrast look. A sleeveless or boat-neck blouse can give it a contemporary finish, while an elbow-sleeve blouse offers a more classic ethnic appearance.

For office or everyday wear, style it with oxidised silver jhumkas, a simple necklace, a watch and comfortable flats. A small bindi and naturally styled hair will complement the saree's relaxed character beautifully.

For a more festive appearance, add statement oxidised jewellery, layered silver necklaces, stacked bangles and embroidered juttis. The mustard-yellow base pairs especially well with antique silver accessories.

Why You'll Love It

This saree combines breathable Mul Cotton comfort with a vibrant mustard-and-midnight-blue colour combination. The contrasting pallu, coordinated blouse piece and tassel detailing give the saree enough character to stand out while keeping the overall design clean and versatile.

From a regular workday to a weekend lunch or intimate celebration, this Mustard Yellow Mul Cotton Saree offers an effortless balance of comfort, colour and contemporary ethnic style.
